sort-match.统计量：它描述“中心”还是“分散”？: Statistics: does each describe center or spread?
sort-match.把每个统计量放进它回答的问题：数据大概在哪里，还是数据有多散？: Place each statistic under the question it answers: where the data lies or how spread out it is.
sort-match.数据有多分散: How spread out the data is
sort-match.平均数把所有数合成一个“典型值”，描述中心位置，不描述散布。: The mean combines values into a typical central location; it does not measure spread.
sort-match.平均数只给出一个中心位置；同一个平均数可以来自很集中、也可以来自很分散的数据。: The same mean can arise from tightly grouped or widely spread data.
sort-match.方差是偏差平方的平均，数据越分散它越大，回答的是“有多散”。: Variance averages squared deviations and grows with dispersion.
sort-match.方差不告诉你数据在哪里：把所有数都加 10，平均数变了，方差一点没变。: Variance does not locate the data: adding 10 changes the mean but leaves variance unchanged.
sort-match.中位数是排好序后正中间的那个数，也是描述中心，而且不容易被极端值带偏。: The median is the middle sorted value, a measure of center less affected by extreme values.
sort-match.中位数是一个位置，不衡量散布。: The median is a location, not a measure of spread.
sort-match.标准差是方差开方，单位和原数据相同，衡量典型的偏离距离。: Standard deviation is the square root of variance, measuring typical deviation in the original units.
sort-match.标准差衡量偏离均值有多远，它不是中心本身。: Standard deviation measures distance from the mean, not the center itself.
sort-match.众数是出现次数最多的值，是另一种“最典型”的值，属于集中趋势。: The mode is the most frequent value, another measure of central tendency.
sort-match.众数只看哪个值最常见，和散布无关。: The mode identifies the most common value, not dispersion.
sort-match.极差 = 最大值 − 最小值，一眼看出数据铺开的范围，是最简单的离散程度。: Range = maximum − minimum, a simple measure of the data's extent.
sort-match.极差是两端之间的距离，不是中心的位置。: Range measures distance between extremes, not central location.
sort-match.四分位距 = Q3 − Q1，是中间一半数据铺开的宽度，不受极端值影响。: IQR = Q3 − Q1, the width of the middle half of the data, resistant to extreme values.
sort-match.四分位距衡量中间一半数据的宽度，不是中心。: IQR measures the width of the middle half, not its center.

step-process.复制一份 DNA：每一格按规则配对: Replicate DNA: follow the pairing rules at each position
step-process.只靠“A 对 T、G 对 C”这一条规则，为什么能得到两份和原来一样的 DNA？: Why does A–T and G–C pairing yield two copies? What happens after one mismatch?
step-process.双链 DNA 由两条链配对而成：上链的 A 对着 T，T 对着 A，G 对着 C: Double-stranded DNA consists of complementary strands: A pairs with T and G pairs with C.
step-process.两条链拉开，各自当模板: Separate the strands; use each as a template
step-process.解旋酶把两条链拉开。每条旧链都露出一排没配对的碱基，等着配新链。: Helicase separates the strands, exposing unpaired bases for new complementary strands.
step-process.新链甲：按规则配: New strand A: follow the pairing rules
step-process.新链甲逐格配对：旧链甲是 A 就配 T，是 T 就配 A，是 G 就配 C，是: Complement template A position by position: A–T, T–A, G–C and C–G.
step-process.新链乙：同样按规则配: New strand B: the same rules
step-process.另一条旧链也一样当模板，规则没有变。: The other existing strand is also a template, with the same rules.
step-process.每份 DNA 都是“一条旧链 + 一条新链”。两份的碱基顺序和原来完全一样，这叫: Each copy has one existing and one new strand, retaining the original sequence: semiconservative replication.
step-process.下一轮：用 DNA① 的下链当模板: Next round: use DNA 1's lower strand as a template
step-process.再复制一轮时，DNA① 的下链也要当模板。它是什么，新配出的链就是什么。: During another round, DNA 1's lower strand determines its new complement.
step-process.在这一步故意出错: Introduce a mistake at this step
step-process.错配的一格留在了新链里，它再被拿去当模板，错误就被抄给下一代。: An unrepaired mismatch remains in the new strand; using it as a template can pass a sequence change to the next generation.
step-process.新链甲：第 4 格配错了: New strand A: mismatch at position 4
step-process.旧链甲第 4 格是 C，应该配 G，这里却放了 A。A 只能配 T，这一格配不上: Template A has C at position 4 and should pair with G, but A was placed here. This is a mismatch.
step-process.另一条链配对没有问题，错误只在新链甲里。: The other strand pairs normally; the error is confined to new strand A.
step-process.得到两份 DNA，其中一份有错配: Two DNA molecules, one with a mismatch
step-process.DNA① 的上下链在第 4 格对不上（C 对 A）。DNA② 是好的。细胞里的修: DNA 1 has C opposite A at position 4. DNA 2 is correct. Cells may repair this, but the example assumes no repair.
step-process.下一轮：错的链当模板: Next round: the incorrect strand becomes a template
step-process.这条下链第 4 格是 A，所以新配出的上链这一格是 T，而不是原来的 C。: Its fourth base is A, so its new complement has T rather than the original C.

timeline-lanes.下载三个文件：同步和异步差在哪？: Downloading three files: synchronous or asynchronous?
timeline-lanes.每个下载都要等 2 秒网络。为什么异步总共不是 6 秒而是约 3 秒？: Each download waits two seconds for the network. Why does the asynchronous case take about three seconds rather than six?
timeline-lanes.同步：每发一个请求，程序就卡住等它回来，三个下载一个接一个排队，等待时间全部加在: Synchronous requests block until each response arrives. Three downloads run in sequence, so waiting times add up.
timeline-lanes.异步：发出请求后不卡住，立刻去发下一个；三个下载在网络上同时进行，等待时间重叠，: Asynchronous requests return without blocking, so all downloads overlap. Total time is only slightly longer than the longest download.
timeline-lanes.播放中：红线往右走，看每条泳道此刻在做什么；拖动滑块可以随时停下来看。: Playing: the red line moves right. Observe each lane, or drag the time slider to pause and inspect.
